NOTICE FROM NATIONAL ANTI-PROFITEERING AUTHORITY UNDER SECTION 171
Notice Ref: NAPA/ND/2023/1010 Dated 05-06-2023
GSTIN: 07QQQRR7890Q1Z6 M/s Horizon Electronics
FY: 2022-23

1. Examination under Section 171 reveals taxpayer failed to pass on benefit of GST rate reduction from 28% to 18% on consumer television units to end consumers by commensurate reduction in prices.
2. You are directed to show cause why profiteered amount of Rs. 15,00,000/- along with interest should not be deposited into Consumer Welfare Fund.
